title.narrative: Strengthening the capacities of rural agroforestry TVET education public schools in Honduras to develop to prevent and manage emergency situations in Honduras.

description.narrative: During 2025, SJO with the support of EME carried out a training of trainers´ initiative targeted to 40 representatives of education communities from 28 rural agroforestry TVET schools in the western dry corridor of Honduras, to prevent and manage emergency situations which frequently affects the country throughout the year. The training was not only an opportunity to have students, teachers´, principals´ and local producers´ empowered to come back to their education communities, but also to provide inputs for developing guidelines and videos (education communication) to help build emergency education plans for each of the represented TVET agroforestry schools. Building on that effort, this incoming funding will create a unique possibility to accompany each of the schools to design collaboratively their plan, including training sessions in their education communities and surrounding populations, which mostly live in poverty and vulnerable conditions, including people in mobility situations (returnees), youth alone (migrating families) and indigenous populations.
